Quests.Title: Ascension: The Broken Ledger
Quests.Summary: Ascension 1/5. A mismatched crystal manifest links the archive, our receivers and a missing handler. Compare the physical records, carry the calibrated sample to Tamsin, then report. No companion required.
Quests.Done: Chapter recorded. Track the next Ascension chapter in JOURNAL.
Quests.Floor: Surface streets and existing ground-floor venues

Lines.Speaker: Corin Pell
Lines.Text: A crystal shipment has two manifests and only one destination. This is optional work, Malik. Read the archive records before blaming either crew. Our receivers will tell us which load is real.

Steps.Objective: Enter Dispatch and read receiver A.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to read the expected pulse
Steps.Objective: Record the clean reference pattern before visiting the archive.
Enter the existing Resonance Archive and examine the first manifest.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to compare the manifest seal
Steps.Objective: Manifest A lists a public utility coupler. Record its destination.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to inspect the altered destination
Steps.Objective: Manifest B was redirected through a handler crossing. Compare its signature.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Those seals were copied from a maintenance return. The altered manifest names a handler, not a smuggler. Take a clean pulse to Tamsin so she can locate the real coupler.

Steps.Objective: Align three QUIET BEAT seals at this physical node. A companion can steady one seal.
Carry the marked parcel to the fitting on foot. Recover it if injury or travel drops it.

Lines.Speaker: Tamsin Reyes
Lines.Text: That pulse belongs to the old garden line. First clear the handler crossing so nobody mistakes her drake for stolen cargo. Corin can request the court without sending a patrol after you.

Steps.Objective: Return to Corin in Dispatch.

Lines.Speaker: Corin Pell
Lines.Text: The copied seal is recorded. Your next chapter requests one finite handler incident. You can mediate or protect the pair. Collect the sealed report at its neutral marker before returning.

Steps.Objective: Leave Dispatch to record the first chapter and receive payment.

Quests.Title: Ascension: A Passage Kept
Quests.Summary: Ascension 2/5. Request one bounded handler incident through the real event director. Reunite the handler and NPC drake, claim the report, then visit the Refuge. Ordinary street cooldowns still apply.
Quests.Done: Chapter recorded. Track the next Ascension chapter in JOURNAL.
Quests.Floor: Surface streets and existing ground-floor venues

Lines.Speaker: Corin Pell
Lines.Text: The route is yours to request at the door. A recent incident may still be cooling down; wait or return later. No extra wave will be dispatched. Merely watching does not count as helping.

Steps.Name: ev_04f_street_drake
Steps.Objective: Request the crossing, reunite the handler and drake, then collect the report at the neutral seal.
Enter Bondkeeper Refuge and check its care station.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to record the handler report
Steps.Objective: Compare the report with the real treatment station. The event drake remains with her handler.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to align the training relay by hand
Steps.Objective: Read this trace by hand at the marker, or use your owned companion exploration assist.

Phases.Title: The second half of the seal

Lines.Speaker: Corin Pell
Lines.Text: The pair crossed safely. Their report points below the Pressure House, through Lantern Refuge and the Pyre Gardens habitat. Tamsin has the practical route. Your own bond roster has not changed.

Steps.Objective: Leave Dispatch to complete the passage chapter. Only this chapter pays for the requested incident.

Quests.Title: Ascension: The Garden Remembers
Quests.Summary: Ascension 3/5. Descend through the real service stair, compare the refuge relay and garden habitat, and trace the coupler. Use companion support or the full manual route. The habitat residents remain protected.
Quests.Done: Chapter recorded. Track the next Ascension chapter in JOURNAL.
Quests.Floor: Existing surface venues and the Underheart

Lines.Speaker: Tamsin Reyes
Lines.Text: The service stair is the real entrance. Follow it to Lantern Refuge, then take the old garden line. Read the habitat equipment, leave its creatures alone, and keep a clean path back. The coupler trail ends in the workshops.

Steps.Objective: Reach the Pressure House service stair and descend on foot.
Reach Lantern Refuge through the existing stair.
Align three QUIET BEAT seals at this physical node. A companion can steady one seal.
Travel to the existing Pyre Gardens habitat. Keep passive wildlife safe.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to read the habitat trace by hand
Steps.Objective: Read this trace by hand at the marker, or use your owned companion exploration assist.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to record the coupler trail
Steps.Objective: Reach the garden vista and record where the resonance enters the Crucible Workshops.

Lines.Speaker: Tamsin Reyes
Lines.Text: The habitat was a witness, not a target. The workshops hold the missing coupler. There is one declared guardian group. Recover the coupler and carry it back; do not disturb the main campaign mechanisms.

Steps.Objective: Return through the service stair and leave the Pressure House to record the habitat chapter.

Quests.Title: Ascension: The Missing Coupler
Quests.Summary: Ascension 4/5. Recover the coupler from one finite workshop guardian group. No reinforcements, no permanent room-clear flag. Carry it back on foot, with dropped-parcel recovery and arena arbitration.
Quests.Done: Chapter recorded. Track the next Ascension chapter in JOURNAL.
Quests.Floor: Existing surface venues and the Underheart

Lines.Speaker: Tamsin Reyes
Lines.Text: One extraction sentinel and two glasswings guard the coupler. That is the entire group. The arena still belongs to the normal encounter system; if another activity holds it, retry when clear. Your main story room state will not be overwritten.

Steps.Objective: Travel through the existing Underheart to the coupler court.
Defeat one sentinel and two glasswings. No reinforcements. Use cover, parry, dodge and melee.
Carry the marked parcel to the fitting on foot. Recover it if injury or travel drops it.

Lines.Speaker: Tamsin Reyes
Lines.Text: Coupler received. The Forge can now teach Ascendant Edge Oil: a paid, temporary melee and guard treatment. Finish the final public circuit before calling the block stable.

Steps.Objective: Leave to record the recovered coupler and unlock the paid Ascendant Edge Oil recipe.

Quests.Title: Ascension: Crystal City Ascension
Quests.Summary: Ascension 5/5. Close the circuit across Dispatch, the Pressure House and Dante forge. Test physical seals, report to the established cast and earn the paid Cityward Infusion recipe. Old quests remain independent.
Quests.Done: Chapter recorded. The block is stable. Cityward Infusion is now known at the Forge. Your original campaign remains available.
Quests.Floor: Existing surface venues and the Underheart

Phases.Title: The public half of the circuit

Lines.Speaker: Corin Pell
Lines.Text: The corrected manifest, safe handler and recovered coupler now agree. We still need a public test: two receivers, the Pressure House and Dante's workshop. Take your time; this is a circuit, not another street war.

Steps.Objective: Align the clean reference receiver. Align three QUIET BEAT prompts. A companion can steady one seal.
Align three QUIET BEAT seals at this physical node. A companion can steady one seal.
Complete the physical Pressure House seal. Align three QUIET BEAT prompts. A companion can steady one seal.

Lines.Speaker: Tamsin Reyes
Lines.Text: Stable under load. Dante can inspect the working sample at his existing forge. There is no new machine to buy and no companion needs to be fused to complete this test.

Steps.Objective: Enter Dante Rook forge through its normal entrance.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to test the forge sample by hand
Steps.Objective: Perform the forge sample test manually, or use an owned companion assist.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: A clean coupler, no scorched casing. Your oil recipe uses real materials; it will not change who owns a focus or make its heat disappear. Corin gets the final report.

Lines.Speaker: Corin Pell
Lines.Text: Ascension circuit recorded. The handler kept her drake, the gardens kept their residents, and the block kept its supply. Cityward Infusion is now known at the Forge. The original campaign and all your earlier work remain yours.

Steps.Objective: Leave Dispatch to record the final chapter and receive its once-only reward.
